card.name: Inside long medical words
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long drug and medical terms split into parts, such as the 'ence' in somnolence, 'actic' in anaphylactic, or 'ine' in carbamazepine-type names. It fires on the piece right after a short opening fragment.

modes.label: Drug name pieces
modes.description: A middle or ending piece of a split drug name, like 'ine' or 'amin' in names such as acetaminophen.

modes.label: Disease or condition term pieces
modes.description: A piece partway through a disease or reaction word.
modes.example: in<<oma>> based on HER2-positive status from tumor

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long medical word that has been broken into pieces, before the word is finished.
